correctness.rationale: The full neighborhood complex has 598 nonempty faces. The stored matching contains 286 disjoint codimension-one pairs; orienting matched Hasse covers upward and all others downward is acyclic by a complete topological-sort check of all 2,067 covers. The only critical cells are one vertex and 25 triangles, which yields a wedge of 25 two-spheres by discrete Morse theory. Independent boundary-rank computations over F_2, F_3, and F_5 all give Betti vector (1,0,25,0,0,0).

value.rationale: The order-13 Paley graph is a canonical symmetric 6-regular circulant and conference graph, lying immediately beyond the published degree-at-most-3 and 4-regular-circulant neighborhood-complex classifications. An exact wedge decomposition supplies a natural next benchmark for the Lovász topological method and is stronger than a Betti-number computation: it determines the full homotopy type by an explicit finite certificate.
